en.name: Nutmeg, ground
en.summary: Ground nutmeg keeps 3–4 years from purchase in a cool, dark cupboard. Like other ground spices it fades rather than spoils — but nutmeg is the clearest case in the whole rack for buying it whole instead.
en.pantry: 3–4 years from purchase in an airtight jar, cool, dark and away from the hob. Nothing grows in a dried ground spice, so this is a flavour window: the oils that carry nutmeg's sweet, resinous smell escape steadily once the seed is broken open. That range is generous, and in practice most people notice the difference long before three years are up. A whole nutmeg is a hard, almost sealed object with very little exposed surface, and a few seconds on a fine grater gives you a smell that no jar of powder can match.
en.fridge: Ground nutmeg does not belong in the fridge. Ground spices are hygroscopic: a cold jar opened in a warm kitchen picks up condensation, and damp nutmeg cakes and can mould. A sealed jar in a cool cupboard is where it belongs.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published either, and the condensation problem is worse in the freezer than in the fridge. With a three-to-four-year cupboard figure this is not a spice that needs cold storage. Buy whole nutmegs and a grater — they keep in a jar in the cupboard for years and lose almost nothing, because there is barely any surface for the air to reach.
en.thawing: Not applicable — ground nutmeg is a dry cupboard spice and should not be frozen.
spoilage: Little or no smell when you warm a pinch in your palm.
A flat, woody dustiness where the sweet resinous note used to be.
Caking into hard lumps from moisture.
Mould or a musty smell in a jar that got damp.
tips: Buy whole nutmegs and grate them; the difference is larger than for any other spice.
Grate over the bowl rather than the pan, so steam does not reach the nutmeg.
Keep the jar out of the light and away from the cooker.
A little goes a long way — an old jar tempts you to overdo it without gaining flavour.

faq.q: How long does ground nutmeg keep?
faq.a: 3–4 years from purchase in an airtight jar in a cool, dark cupboard.
No. Dried spices fade rather than spoil. An old jar is weak, not unsafe — only a damp, mouldy jar should be thrown out.
Yes, and noticeably so. A whole nutmeg has almost no exposed surface, so it holds its aroma for years, and grating releases it fresh.

zh.name: 肉豆蔻粉
zh.summary: 肉豆蔻粉自購買日起，放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃可放 3～4 年。和其他研磨香料一樣，它是淡掉而不是腐敗——但在整個香料架上，它大概是最值得「改買整顆」的那一個。
zh.pantry: 氣密罐、陰涼、避光、遠離爐台，自購買日起 3～4 年。乾燥的研磨香料裡長不出東西，所以這是風味的窗口：種子一被磨開，帶著肉豆蔻那股甜而樹脂味香氣的精油就持續在跑。這個範圍算是寬鬆的，實務上多數人在三年之前就會察覺差別。整顆肉豆蔻是一個堅硬、幾乎密封的物體，暴露的表面極少；用細刨刀刨幾秒鐘釋放出來的香氣，是任何一罐粉都比不上的。
zh.fridge: 肉豆蔻粉不屬於冰箱。研磨香料會吸濕：冰過的罐子在溫暖廚房打開就會結露，而受潮的肉豆蔻會結塊，也可能發霉。它該待的地方，是陰涼櫥櫃裡的密封罐。
zh.freezer: 冷凍同樣沒有期限數據，而且結露問題比冷藏更嚴重。既然櫥櫃就有三到四年，這不是需要低溫保存的香料。請買整顆肉豆蔻加一支刨刀——它在櫥櫃的罐子裡放好幾年幾乎不掉味，因為空氣根本碰不到什麼表面。
zh.thawing: 不適用——肉豆蔻粉是乾燥的櫥櫃香料，不應冷凍。
spoilage: 在手心搓熱一小撮，幾乎聞不到味道。
原本甜甜的樹脂香變成平板的木質灰塵味。
受潮的罐子長霉或有霉味。
tips: 買整顆現刨；它的差別比任何其他香料都大。
在碗上方刨而不是在鍋子上方，避免蒸氣碰到肉豆蔻。
一點點就很夠——舊罐子會誘使你越加越多，卻加不出味道。

faq.a: 氣密罐放陰涼避光的櫥櫃，自購買日起 3～4 年。

faq.q: 放很久的肉豆蔻粉有危險嗎？
faq.a: 沒有。乾燥香料是淡掉而不是腐敗。舊罐子只是味道弱；只有受潮發霉的才該丟。

faq.q: 整顆肉豆蔻真的比較好嗎？
faq.a: 是，而且差很多。整顆幾乎沒有暴露的表面，香氣能保住好幾年，現刨才是新鮮釋放出來的。
